beamng_fsr_framegen.title: AMD FSR Frame Generation
beamng_fsr_framegen.tagline: AMD FSR Frame Generation for BeamNG.drive, with Anti-Lag 2
beamng_fsr_framegen.description: Adds AMD FSR Frame Generation to BeamNG.drive's Direct3D 12 renderer, with ML frame generation on RDNA 4 hardware, analytical frame generation on everything else that qualifies, and AMD Radeon Anti-Lag 2 where the driver provides it. Works entirely on its own — the separate AMD FSR Upscaling product is optional and neither requires the other. This mod ZIP is only half of the integration: BeamNG's Lua sandbox cannot load native code, so the frame generation itself runs in a native bridge installed alongside BeamNG.drive.exe. See docs/INSTALL.md. Without the bridge this mod does nothing except tell you it is missing.
beamng_fsr_framegen.license: MIT (mod). AMD FSR runtime redistributed under AMD's own licence — see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
beamng_fsr_framegen.requirements: Windows 10/11 (Windows 11 for ML frame generation), BeamNG.drive with the Direct3D 12 renderer, the native FSR bridge installed
